correctness.rationale: Direct graph reconstruction yielded 24 indexed edges, 951 augmented matching faces with nonempty face vector (24,172,416,306,32). Rebuilt the deterministic 468 matched pairs from the exact edge-order pivot, and topologically sorted all 951 faces in the full modified Hasse graph (3000 incidences): acyclic. Eleven critical 3-faces and four critical 2-faces remain; exact signed gradient recursions yield the displayed 4x11 integer Morse boundary with rows 2=3 and row1+row2+row4=0. Its Smith diagonal is (1,1); nonzero unit minor ensures no torsion. The Morse CW model has no 1-cells, so Hurewicz classifies all 3-cell attachments by this integral matrix and cancels two pairs, leaving 2 S2 + 9 S3. Independent derivation agreed with RESULT.md, not just the packaged log.
